**NVIDIA's Most Recent Fiscal Year Revenue**

| Fiscal Year End | Revenue |
|---|---|
| January 25, 2026 (FY2026) | **$215.94 billion** |

NVIDIA reported **$215,938,000,000** (~$215.9 billion) in revenue for its fiscal year ending **January 25, 2026**, as filed with the SEC on February 25, 2026.

This represents a remarkable scale for the company, driven primarily by explosive demand for its AI-focused data center GPUs (such as the H100 and Blackwell architectures). For context, this is a dramatic increase from the ~$60 billion range NVIDIA was in just two fiscal years prior — a reflection of the AI infrastructure boom.

> ⚠️ *This is educational analysis based on SEC-reported figures, not investment advice.*
